description: Registry of MCP servers wired into the hitcon-range-sprint agent framework. Source of truth; see README.md for the wiring policy.

policy.import_mode: reference external snapshot (Security-LabData/external-mcp-tools/<name>) and pin upstream commit, release version, and any submodule commit; do not vendor server source
policy.holder_node: Primary Analysis Gateway (host LabStrix), in a dedicated version-pinned runtime; never the host default interpreter when deps pin an older Python
policy.secrets: environment variables only; never committed; registry records variable names, not values
